title: Fairlight Secan 3.0 in Moorland Silver
content:
UK brand Fairlight Cycles‘ new Secan 3.0 paint, Moorland Silver, is inspired by the silver hued grasses carpeting the moorlands surrounding Fairlight’s riding terrain. Moorland Silver is a metallic paint that comes in on the warmer spectrum, rather than the cooler side, with a lovely champagne warmth that comes through in low light. As with all Secan and Strael finish options, it is hand-sprayed and emery-clothed between every layer. The result is a premium, liquid finish with depth and shine.

Fairlight’s first batch has arrived this week, so if you’re interested, roll on over to Fairlight to see more.
